note: Inputs for the harmonizer's crosswalks (spec 02). Free, redistributable Census products only; IPUMS NHGIS is excluded by its terms.

2010-2020.method: 2020 block population (PL 94-171 P1_001), split across 2010x2020 block intersections by intersecting land area, summed to tract pairs and normalized per 2010 tract. Tracts with no 2020 population fall back to land area.
2010-2020.validation: Pair land areas must equal Census's 2020-2010 tract relationship file (independent product). HUD-USPS ratios need an API token; Geocorr is form-only. Both are pending as further references.
